triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var sourcePlayer = battle.players.find(function(p) { return p.playerId === self.ownerId; }); if (!sourcePlayer) return false; return battle.turn.currentPlayerId !== sourcePlayer.playerId; }
